subject.title: Feature: Talk Mode Idle Timeout / Auto-Deactivation After Voice Wake

question: What public Talk idle-timeout contract should OpenClaw support for deactivating inactive Talk sessions after Voice Wake starts them?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix would add public lifecycle and config behavior across Talk surfaces, so automation should not choose the durable product contract alone.

options.title: Approve additive Talk idle timeout
options.body: Add a canonical Talk config field with explicit units, limits, disabled behavior, and reset events, then wire it through config, protocol, docs, and the macOS runtime.

options.title: Scope only to Voice Wake-started Talk
options.body: Track activation source and auto-deactivate only sessions started from Voice Wake, leaving manually started Talk sessions unchanged.

options.title: Defer to broader voice lifecycle design
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers design a larger Talk/Voice Wake lifecycle that also covers realtime sessions and mobile behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve additive Talk idle timeout
recommendation.body: Add a canonical Talk config field with explicit units, limits, disabled behavior, and reset events, then wire it through config, protocol, docs, and the macOS runtime.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses Talk config, protocol, docs, and product policy surfaces where steipete has the strongest current history.
